$comment: Sketch of this app on manifest v2 (Platform v2, plans section 12: V1 catalog fragment, V3 documents with one owner, V6 handles, V7 native pane, V10 owner taxonomy, V11 typed watch streams, gesture tokens, l10n, variants). Not loaded by today's runtime; cmux-app.json is the runnable v1 manifest.

documents.$comment: The notes server is the document host for every note (one owner per document): buffer, revision, unsaved-buffer journal, conflicts. Views edit with document.edit {doc, base_revision, edits}; a stale base is refused with revision.conflict.

scopes.workspace:read: Show the scratchpad of the workspace you are in and label notes with workspace names.

optionalScopes.fs:read: Import the Markdown files you pick (a handle per pick; no other file is reachable).
optionalScopes.fs:write: Export notes as Markdown files into a folder you pick (a handle per pick).

cmux.pane/1.$comment: The only native pane for now (first-party). Contract in README, 'The editor pane'.

catalog.$comment: Ops of the notes server: catalog/notes-catalog.json (owner app:cmux/notes). The agent tools are those ops with mcp: default (note.list, note.get, note.create, note.append, note.capture, note.search); no JS runs for them. The app adds only client commands below.

title.ja: Markdownファイルをメモとして読み込む…

variants.$comment: DEV/NIGHTLY prototypes (x-cmux-devOnly); the platform adds the 'Next Notes Variant' palette entry and the Settings picker.

scratchpad.en: This workspace's scratchpad open on top, then the other notes.

list.en: Notes with the selected one shown inline.

editor.en: Rows only; a click opens the note in the editor pane.
